cause: EditorWork called Pillow validation inside Unreal embedded Python. Pillow in the host authoring Python does not install it in Unreal.
fix: Editor requests full validation via a short-lived authoring Python subprocess. Engine Python imports only stdlib and the local policy module. No engine pip install.
reproduction: A real python -S interpreter cannot import PIL and the old in-process validator rejects the genuine PNG/JPG sources. From that same isolated interpreter, the authoring subprocess verifies all real sources.
tests: No-Pillow editor environment with real separate authoring Python
